title: Agent outcome report
description: Written once by an implementation agent for the attempt it currently holds. It reports what happened and is never itself authority: a completed report is attached to a result only when PtcManager's own Git probe finds the same head, and a stopped report is displayed to the maintainer rather than acted on automatically.

schema_version.description: The contract this report was written against.

outcome.description: What happened to this attempt. There is exactly one report path, so an attempt cannot claim both.

head_sha.description: The exact commit the agent believes it left on the branch, as Git reports it for this repository's object format. PtcManager accepts the report only when its own probe finds this head, so a wrong value discards the report rather than moving the job.

summary.description: What changed, in plain language. No secrets, no raw command output.

validation.description: How the change was checked and what that showed. No secrets, no raw command output.

retrospective.description: What the attempt leaves behind: follow-up work worth tracking, and anything about the repository's own instructions that was missing, wrong, or had to be guessed at. Say so plainly when there is nothing.

reason_code.description: Why the agent stopped. This decides which recovery PtcManager offers first.

summary.description: One plain sentence a maintainer can read on a card. No secrets, no command output.

detail.description: What was attempted and what failed, in plain language. No secrets, no raw command output.

prerequisite.description: The exact name of the one missing thing, when there is one: an environment variable, binary, or service.

progress.description: Whether anything was committed to the branch before stopping.
